purpose: Reviewed proposals for moving capabilities between Labs. Draft only: no runtime effect.

migrations.reason: Finance can benefit from reviewed expert or operator notes, but must adapt them to regime-hypothesis fields.
required_changes: define finance_regime_review_card fields
map source/provider, asset/window, hypothesis, metric, baseline/null, leakage guard, decision boundary and falsifier
render card in admin without treating it as seed
ground THIA in finance role and no-signal boundary
non_admissible_transfer: BTC fields such as POC, FVG, LVN, CME gap or MM52
verification: admin shows sources and missing limits
THIA does not claim Finance Lab was updated

migrations.reason: BTC cross-feed robustness can become provider/dataset/version robustness for finance.
required_changes: define finance source agreement metrics
compare yfinance/coingecko or versioned dataset constraints where available
make provider errors and stale data visible
block promotion when source status is insufficient
non_admissible_transfer: exchange close-dispersion thresholds copied from BTC
assuming provider agreement implies market claim validity
verification: source disagreement downgrades verdict or marks review_required

migrations.reason: Finance has multi-window/multi-horizon regimes; the BTC timeframe matrix may transfer as scale admissibility, not trading timeframe selection.
required_changes: rename to finance horizon/window admissibility matrix
define denominator per asset/window
require shuffle/block null per horizon
exclude best-timeframe language
verification: each horizon has denominator or block reason

migrations.reason: Physics scale/finite-size sweep and BTC timeframe matrix look like one larger multi-scale admissibility family.
required_changes: compare physics scale sweep with BTC timeframe matrix
define generic scale_admissibility_matrix capability
declare valid_when and retire_when
avoid importing physics content into non-physics domains
non_admissible_transfer: physics invariants copied as content to other domains
scale matrix used without domain-native null
verification: capability doc distinguishes scale as denominator from scale as display
at least two domain examples exist before generator promotion

migrations.reason: BTC testing exposed role confusion: THIA may speak as if the visitor is admin/operator or as if admin persistence updates the Lab.
required_changes: define role context per surface
make visitor/expert/admin/operator distinction explicit
test THIA responses after intake, file upload and admin save
ensure saved intake is described as review/quarantine, not Lab update
non_admissible_transfer: generic role prompt that ignores domain context
hiding admin/operator difference from public user
verification: THIA does not claim privilege it lacks
visitor is not treated as admin
expert is unverified unless operator verifies
admin intake save is not described as seed update

migrations.reason: File/chat/admin intake and packet continuity create multiple persistence surfaces where secrets must not be copied.
required_changes: inventory persistence surfaces
define block/redact policy per surface
reuse existing contribution redaction where available
add tests before enabling runtime enforcement
non_admissible_transfer: silent redaction that hides data loss from operator
verification: common token patterns blocked or redacted
no secret echo in admin or packets
